info.title: PageSift Backend API
info.description: PageSift backend API for extension authentication, account settings, project organization, and explicitly saved design artifacts.

get.summary: Readiness probe checking PostgreSQL connectivity with timeout

post.summary: Initiate Google OAuth 2.0 / OIDC sign-in with PKCE

get.summary: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC callback from Google returning a PKCE-locked handoff code

post.summary: Exchange single-use handoff code and client PKCE codeVerifier for session tokens
Rotate refresh token and issue new access token
Revoke current session or all sessions for the authenticated account

delete.summary: Delete the authenticated account and cascade cleanup of all owned data

put.summary: Replace authenticated account preferences with strictly validated settings

post.summary: Create a new project owned by the authenticated account

get.summary: List projects owned by the authenticated account with deterministic cursor pagination
Retrieve a project by ID (enforcing ownership)

patch.summary: Update a project with optimistic concurrency control (expectedVersion)

delete.summary: Delete an owned project and cascade cleanup of its saved artifacts

post.summary: Save a versioned artifact under an owned project

get.summary: List artifact metadata for an owned project without loading artifact bodies
Retrieve full artifact metadata and body content
